title: oryzopsis miliacea subsp. thomasii
intro: Oryzopsis miliacea subsp. thomasii, commonly known as Thomas's Rice Grass or Puccoon, is a plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of Oryzopsis miliacea subsp. thomasii, and its use should be approached with caution.
